map.年龄天数计算是做什么的？: What does Age in Days do?
map.如何使用年龄天数计算？: How do I use Age in Days?
map.年龄天数计算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Age in Days best for?
map.从出生日到现在经过的天数 / 时 / 分 / 秒: Days / hours / minutes / seconds elapsed from the birth date to now
map.累计天数 =（当前时刻 − 出生日期）÷ 86400 秒；小时、分钟、秒依次对上: Total days = (current moment − birth date) ÷ 86400 seconds; hours, minutes and seconds are obtained by taking the remainder against the next higher unit in turn; 1 year counts as 365.25 days (a leap year adds 1 day every 4 years, and a century year is a leap year only if divisible by 400), and the result can be further converted into weeks, months and other spans.
map.计算两个日期之间的精确时长: Compute the exact duration between two dates
map.注：仅作计算参考，不含精确历法转换: Note: for calculation reference only, without exact calendar conversion
map.算出生至今总天数。: Compute the total number of days from birth to today.
map.宝宝满百天、满周岁等成长节点按总天数记录，方便制作成长纪念。: Growth milestones such as a baby reaching the 100th day or first birthday can be recorded in total days, handy for making keepsakes.
map.按区间天数计，是否含当天视设定。: Counted as an interval of days; whether the current day is included depends on the setting.
map.闰年会影响天数吗？: Do leap years affect the day count?
map.会。页面按实际历法逐日累加，闰年的 2 月 29 日计入，因此结果比按 365: Yes. The page adds up day by day on the actual calendar, counting 29 February in leap years, so the result is more accurate than a flat 365-day estimate.
map.年龄天数计算。日常生活工具，贴近生活，实用便捷。: Age in Days. A daily-life tool that is practical and convenient.
